title: Instrumentation for kernel routing decisions across generation stages
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add end-to-end telemetry to surface the runtime's kernel routing heuristics during generation stages (prefill and decode). Deliver NVTX ranges, trace spans, and per-kernel metrics that allow correlation between routing decisions (kernel variant chosen, quantized path, fused attention) and end-to-end latency/cost for requests.
background: We have scattered kernel-level telemetry (NVTX annotations, some per-kernel counters) but lack a coherent signal tying routing decisions to request-level outcomes. Teams need to answer: why was a slower kernel chosen for a particular request? did a cache hit change kernel choice? are attention heuristics steering execution onto slower fusion codepaths under certain sequence-length distributions?
proposal: 1) Define a compact telemetry envelope attached to trace spans with: kernel_id, kernel_variant_tags (quantized|fused|atten-optimized), heuristic_score, decision_reason (capacity|latency-estimate|compatibility), input_cohort (seq_len_bucket, kv_cache_hit). 2) Emit NVTX ranges for the routing decision and immediately show chosen kernel as an enriched span so exporters can attribute time to kernel choice vs execution. 3) Increment per-kernel counters (invocations, tokens_processed, avg_latency) and export as metrics with request-oriented labels (route_id, model_family, generation_stage). 4) Add a sampling policy that biases detailed traces toward borderline decision cases (score within delta threshold).
tradeoffs:
- Cost: extra instrumentation increases CPU/alloc overhead and metric cardinality. We mitigate by compact tags and targeted sampling.
- Complexity: adding another decision envelope complicates current span model; we propose a harmonized schema to avoid span explosion.
- Data volume vs signal: fine-grained per-token kernel metrics give great insight but cost; we limit to per-invocation aggregates plus sampled per-phase traces.
tasks: define telemetry envelope schema and field names
implement routing-decision NVTX range around the kernel selection hotpath
emit enriched trace span with kernel_id and decision_reason
add per-kernel metric counters and labels to prometheus exporter
implement sampler that prioritizes traces where heuristic_score is within 10% of threshold
dashboard: build a per-model kernel routing heatmap and a decision-attribution view
integration tests and perf regression run against benchmark suite
documentation: SDK/telemetry spec and migration notes
acceptance_criteria: routing decision span is present in traces for >=90% of instrumented requests under sampling policy
prometheus metrics show per-kernel invocation and avg_latency with labels: model_family, generation_stage
dashboard surfaces examples where decision_reason=capacity and latency impact >10ms
end-to-end perf overhead under sampling <=3% p90 for typical load
internal review & signoff from runtime and observability teams
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Created ticket. Spike yesterday showed clear cases where attention-fusion selection increased latency on short sequences due to mis-estimated cost. Need spans to prove hypothesis.
2026-03-11 Marco Alvarez: Prototype emits 'routing.decision' NVTX range and attaches kernel_id tag. Measured 1.8% CPU overhead at 1000 RPS with 5% sampling. Pushed PR for early review.

2026-03-11 RDS (observability): Please ensure tag cardinality is bounded — suggest seq_len_bucket (<=64,65-256,>256) rather than raw seq_len. Also prefer normalized kernel families like 'matmul-fused-v1' not raw pointers.

2026-03-12 Sienna Cho (runtime): Noted a potential race when routing decision reads scheduler state; added a small lock-free snapshot to avoid inconsistent decision_reason labels. Needs perf run.
